candidates.description: This feature vector represents numeric values indicating quantities, measurements, or counts.
This vector activates in contexts involving verbs of utilization, application, and instrumental action.
This feature vector represents modal verbs and auxiliary terms related to possibility, capability, and obligation across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents common Spanish action verbs in their infinitive form.
This vector represents common adjectives and descriptive states indicating ease, difficulty, importance, or likelihood.
These tokens are common Spanish verbal roots, prefixes, and high-frequency action-related words.
This vector represents general, actual, and specific qualifiers indicating typicality or reality.
These tokens represent demonstrative pronouns and determiners across Romance languages, primarily Spanish and French.
This vector activates on word prefixes and roots starting with the letters "Co" or "Com" across multiple languages.
This vector represents the concept of importance, significance, or scale.
